seamPolicy.equirectHorizontal: periodic, sampled with wrap-around; no black border
seamPolicy.equirectPoles: clamped to the last row (half-texel polar caps)
seamPolicy.cubeEdges: shared by geometry; no separate border pixels

filtering.equirectToCube: area integration of the exact projected footprint per face texel; longitude intervals are periodic, latitude bands use exact spherical solid angle; degenerate near-unit footprints use bilinear reconstruction
filtering.cubeToEquirect: stratified direction supersampling sized from the direction Jacobian; samples within one texel of a face edge blend both faces to avoid seams

notes: All faces are generated by projection; no face is hand-drawn.
No face is vertically flipped: image down is a world-space down component for every face.
Cube->equirect is a resampling operation and is not byte-lossless.

metrics.note: Round-trip loss is real: the cube->equirect pass integrates over cube texels, so high-frequency detail above the cube rate is removed. No byte-for-byte identity is claimed.
